title: Continuity Rate and the Member's Visit Cadence (Primary Care Provider Assignment)
content:
**Clinical cadence note — Primary Care Provider Assignment, continuity of care with an exiting provider.**

The visits in the last half-year set the continuity rate — the visits per ninety-day period at which a member who elects continuity of care is expected to keep seeing the exiting provider. The continuity rate is set by how often the member has been seeing the assigned provider in the last half-year:

- a member with at least **3** visits (the active-treatment count) in the last half-year keeps the current cadence, so the rate is the number of visits with the assigned provider in the last quarter;
- a member with one visit, or more but fewer than 3 — that is, **1 or 2** visits — in the last half-year is set at the maintenance continuity rate of **1** visit;
- a member with no visit in the last half-year is set at the standard continuity rate.

**Periods.** The last quarter and the last half-year are trailing periods of **3** and **6 whole months** counted back from the handling date, not calendar quarters or halves: a visit is inside a period of a given number of months when fewer than that number of whole months separate its date from the handling date, so a visit dated exactly that number of months back is outside it.

**Input, judgement, output**

| Visits with the assigned provider in the last 6 months | Visits in the last 3 months | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | 3 | 3 (current cadence) |
| 3 | 1 | 1 (current cadence) |
| 3 | 0 | 0 (current cadence) |
| 2 | 2 | 1 (maintenance rate) |
| 1 | 0 | 1 (maintenance rate) |
| 0 | 0 | The standard continuity rate |

**Worked case (hypothetical, handling date 15 September 2026).** Visits on 10 April, 20 May, 1 July and 28 August 2026. All four are inside the last 6 months (the 6-month boundary is 15 March 2026), so the current cadence applies; the visits on 1 July and 28 August are inside the last 3 months (boundary 15 June 2026), so the rate is 2.
